Set fire to the galley.

There is some broken glass.

Neither did Aunty Jackie, and she's just over the ridge.

Shotgun blast up close? No.

You need to go up the hill.

I want you to phone the hospital in Lerwick,
use the landline, but try not to contaminate anything

set up a common approach path,
and put up a windshield.

Yeah.
Can I cover her up?
Yeah. You did the right thing.
Take as many as you can. The body, the surrounding area, and inside the croft, and then email them to Inverness.
Do you think you can manage that?
Of course. You sure? Because your eyes look like piss holes in the snow.
Sorry, late night. I thought I was off duty.
We're never off duty here.
You still not got that yet?
No?
Sorry for your loss. Must be stunned.
I'm going to have to ask you a few questions.
You passed by the Croft last night.
Aye.
I was just on my way home.
He was drinking over in Lerwick, like he does every night.
Look, I'm no long back for sea.
I don't know what to do with myself.
Now get off my back! For God's sake!
All right?
These days, the deep-sea ships only do two or three long trips a year.

She was actually quite excited.

I didn't go anywhere near my mischraft.
Now... If you don't mind.
Yes. The other day, it was pouring down.
My mum was like that jacket.

No. No, I was with her last night.
What time? I left Kelly about nine.
I stopped in and had a quick drink with her.
Momma was a bit funny at the dig earlier.
Sophie and I were working in the trench with Jackie. She'd volunteered to help.
Jackie Aldine's a bones mother. That's right.

Human skull.

No.

I called my...

Pasta should be served al dente. Oh, is that right? Well, you can have yours al fresco if you like.
Can I go over to Molly's after?
Uh, no. Why? Because it's late. It's getting dark.
And there's a killer on the loose...
Looks like hard work. It was.
We're not sure yet if Mima's family will let us continue digging here.

They fast-track the brainy ones like me.
Is there anything missing?
Only tales from other people about my father.
Name I never, never talked about.

Aye, brave man.

No matter.

DC Macintosh, if you don't mind, Drew.

Scandinavian-looking.
Wearing a Gore-Tex waterproof.
